children: Tandem Diabetes shares rose after it logged higher sales and named a new chief executive.
The stock gained 8% to $19.50 in after-hours trading after closing down 6%.

The diabetes technology company appointed Jeannette Bankes as chief executive, succeeding John Sheridan. Sheridan's planned retirement is set for the end of 2026 after more than a decade at the company.
Bankes has experience at GE Healthcare, Merck, Boston Scientific and Alcon.
Sales in the third quarter rose 14% to $283.7 million. Sales in the U.S. increased 9%, while international revenue was up 27%.
Tandem's loss narrowed to $7.1 million, or 10 cents a share, from a loss of $21.2 million, or 31 cents a share, the year before.
The company reaffirmed its full-year guidance.
